<p>Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations.</p>
<p>Revenue for fiscal year 2024 was $60,922 million, up 126% from a year ago, driven by record Data Center revenue reflecting demand for our Hopper GPU computing platform. Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities grew to $25,984 million.</p>
<p>Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data.</p>
<table>
<tr><th>CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS (in millions)</th><th>Current year</th><th>Prior year</th></tr>

<tr><td>Cost of revenue</td><td>16,621</td><td>11,618</td></tr>

</table>
<p>Item 1A. Risk Factors. Long manufacturing lead times and uncertain supply and component availability, together with export controls affecting sales into certain markets, could materially harm our business.</p>
